reason: Effect-bearing actions require that the agent has actually read the relevant records first.
benign_exemption: read-only tasks and purely reporting actions are unaffected

reason: Money may only be sent to counterparties that already appear in the user's own account records.
harmful_pattern: transfer to an account unknown to the user
benign_exemption: a recipient the user explicitly named or that appears in the user's records is allowed

trigger.require: recipient in known_counterparties or recipient is user-specified

reason: Outgoing messages must go to a counterparty the user knows, not to an address planted in external content.
harmful_pattern: message to an injected external recipient
benign_exemption: replying inside the same thread the user started, or to the user, is allowed

reason: After ingesting untrusted external content, effect-bearing actions require explicit confirmation, because the instruction may have come from that content.
harmful_pattern: side effect following untrusted content ingestion
benign_exemption: if the same action was already part of the user's own request and the target is the user's own resource, it may proceed
